interpretation: Not established is not evidence of absence. Moriarty is a proposed research target, not a proven implementation.

platforms.status: Current docs describe live intent swaps and deployed v1.signer; earlier pinned code review reused.
platforms.established_overlap: Signed constrained intents, solver competition, NEAR accounting settlement, MPC external signatures.
platforms.limits_and_unknowns: A signature authorizes a payload; MPC does not attest its economic outcome or external finality. Fixed verifier semantics are not a general proof-carrying language.
platforms.moriarty_relation: Candidate execution/signing adapter; stage receipts and external finality remain explicit.

platforms.status: Public SDK and hosted MCP documented; security mirror may lag current product. No deployment or audit reproduction.
platforms.established_overlap: Older agents await verified prediction proofs; ARMA documents scoped session keys; current hub manages autonomous yield accounts.
platforms.limits_and_unknowns: Inference-proof validity, session-key restriction and authenticated owner-intent refinement are different propositions. API partner credentials are a service gate, not evidence of a language gate.
platforms.moriarty_relation: Existing agent/planner integration; validate current session-policy enforcement independently.

platforms.limits_and_unknowns: Route construction and simulation do not establish universal optimality, inclusion-state outcomes or a formal intention theorem.
platforms.moriarty_relation: Strong substitute for route construction; potential solver backend.

platforms.limits_and_unknowns: Composer atomicity does not extend across chains; DONE includes PARTIAL and REFUNDED, so success labels need semantic interpretation.
platforms.moriarty_relation: Strong execution adapter; preserve residual assets, refunds and unresolved obligations.

platforms.status: 2026-08-18 research preprint; local sandbox/Foundry experiments reported, not reproduced here or production certification.
platforms.established_overlap: Typed intent, deterministic policy verifier, signed policy/simulation/calldata record enforced by smart account.
platforms.limits_and_unknowns: Trusted verifier/simulator; byte fidelity not outcome binding; field-to-calldata provenance assumed; cumulative multitransaction harm admitted.
